messages:
jess (support): FYI, customer AcmeCorp flagged a messed up credit note after a mid-cycle downgrade. They had a PO marked VAT-exempt but the credit note shows VAT charged on the prorated amount.

billing-bot: New ticket #TCK-4428 created for invoice INV-2026-0456 (linked: https://invoices.redwood/acme/INV-2026-0456).

maria (finance): Oof. Can you paste the invoice + credit note lines? Need to see how tax was applied.

jess (support): Pasting redacted lines: 
```
Invoice INV-2026-0456 (2026-09-03)
- Plan: Pro yearly (start 2026-07-01, end 2027-07-01) gross 12000.00 USD, VAT 20% -> tax 2400.00, net 9600.00
Credit NOTE CR-2026-089 (issued 2026-10-15) after downgrade to Basic
- Prorated refund for remaining 270 days: gross 9000.00, VAT shown 1800.00, net credited 7200.00
PO: PO-ACME-556 (VAT-exempt flag true)
```

sam (cs): The customer insists their PO has VAT exemption (government contract). They attached the signed PO. They only want the net amount returned, zero VAT.

lee (payments): Quick question: was the VAT exemption flag set on the invoice or on the customer profile at time of credit note generation?

alex (eng-billing): I reproduced locally: our proration flow computes prorated gross first, then applies tax calculation in a separate step. The VAT-exempt check currently runs only when generating the original invoice, not on dynamic credits. So the credit path missed the exemption.

maria (finance): That explains it. Two things: (1) immediate manual fix for the customer — issue a corrected credit note for net-only; (2) longer-term code fix + backfill for affected credits. Estimated affected count?

alex (eng-billing): Running a quick query now for credits generated by proration where customer.vat_exempt = true but credit.tax_amount > 0. I'll post numbers in a few mins.

billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT count(*) FROM credits WHERE source='proration' AND tax_amount>0 AND customer_vat_exempt=true; (job 99823).

alex (eng-billing): Result: 14 credits in prod (since Jul 2026). Total tax overcharged ~ $12,400. Most are mid-cycle downgrades.

maria (finance): OK. For each we need: corrected credit note (net only), ledger adjustment entry to move tax reversal, and a customer-facing note. Prioritize >$1k tax impact.

jess (support): For AcmeCorp they're owed $1,500 VAT back. They want the corrected credit today if possible.

lee (payments): Manual workaround for now: create a manual credit record with tax_amount=0 and link to INV-2026-0456, then void CR-2026-089. I can do a manual payment ledger entry — will need GL codes: use CR-REFUND (liability) and TAX_REVERSAL.

maria (finance): Confirm GL details: credit memo -> account 2100 (deferred revenue adj), tax reversal -> 2200. That should balance. Sam, please send the customer a short note explaining we're issuing a corrected credit and ETA.

sam (cs): Drafting message: "Thanks — we've identified the issue and will issue a corrected credit note reflecting your VAT exemption. You should see the updated credit and ledger entry by EOD. Apologies for the inconvenience." Will post for review.

alex (eng-billing): For the code fix: change proration pipeline to evaluate customer.tax_status earlier, before computing tax. Proposed patch: 
```patch
- prorated_gross = compute_proration(...)
- tax = compute_tax(prorated_gross, invoice.tax_rate)
+ if customer.vat_exempt:
+   tax = 0
+   prorated_net = compute_proration_net(...)
+ else:
+   prorated_gross = compute_proration(...)
+   tax = compute_tax(prorated_gross, invoice.tax_rate)
```
I'll open PR and include a migration to re-evaluate credits for affected accounts.

maria (finance): Any risk to accounting by changing ordering? Need sign-off from tax counsel for corner cases (partial exemptions, reverse charge). I'll loop in legal if needed.

alex (eng-billing): Reasonable. I'll add feature-flagged rollout and a dry-run job that outputs candidate corrected credits (no ledger writes) so finance can review before backfill.

lee (payments): For immediate manual fix on AcmeCorp, I can create the manual credit and post ledger entries now. Who approves? Maria?

maria (finance): Approve. Please attach the manual journal id to the ticket and cc me.

sam (cs): Sent to AcmeCorp: "We issued a corrected credit note CR-2026-089-C (net only). Ledger adjustment JRN-9981 recorded. Please confirm receipt and let us know if you'd like a remittance advice."

jess (support): Customer replied: ":white_check_mark: Received and confirmed. Thanks!"

maria (finance): Next steps action list: 
- [ ] Alex: PR + dry-run job (due 2026-10-22)
- [ ] Lee: Manual corrections for top 5 impacted customers (today)
- [ ] Finance: prepare journal entries and customer notifications (today)
- [ ] Legal: confirm VAT-exemption handling edge cases (ASAP)

alex (eng-billing): I'll post the dry-run output to the ticket and tag finance when ready. Thanks all.

billing-bot: Ticket #TCK-4428 updated: status -> in_progress.

sam (cs): Closing the loop for AcmeCorp — mark as resolved once ledger shows cleared.

maria (finance): Thanks team. If anyone finds more than expected, escalate to exec finance.
